format: UCWDC Couples Open and Masters age divisions (future UCWDC body profile)

source.quote_free_summary: Open and Masters competitors must be adults, except in couples where an adult may dance with a partner aged 16 or above.

requirement: The partner-aged-16-or-above exception is NOT available in the initial Studio/Custom release: DanceFlow's OD-02 launch restriction prohibits all competitors under 18. The setup wizard states this next to the Masters/Open age divisions. A future UCWDC profile that lifts OD-02 must model the exception deliberately.
enforcement_point: Wording only (division axis note). Enforcement of the under-18 refusal is OD-02 (PR 835), not part of this change; DanceFlow does not enforce UCWDC age eligibility.
interpretation_notes: Re-read 2026-11-23 in the pinned PDF (II.D.3, page 3 of 17): 'Masters division competitors must be Adults, except in couples where an Adult may dance with a partner who is 16 years of age or above.' II.D.3.a says the same for Open. Not implemented, by owner decision OD-32 (AE-08).
